Prepositional Prefixes

A preposition is a word that is placed before a noun or pronoun to show the relationship between that word and another word in the sentence. A prefix is a group of letters placed at the beginning of a word to modify its meaning.

Adding Emphasis

You can choose to add emphasis on certain words when you want to stress a certain point or call attention to a certain detail. When you pronounce these words, you say them longer and louder than the surrounding words.
